## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] UI changes checked with the keyboard (and a screen reader if possible)
- [ ] Guides, README or CHANGELOG updated for user-facing changes

## Local-first check

- [ ] No new analytics, telemetry or third-party requests (or discussed first and listed in Settings › Data & Privacy)
